script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Silent Watcher

INT. SMART APARTMENT - NIGHT

Our hero, JAMES RUSSELL, a brilliant but socially awkward computer scientist in his early 30s,
sits in front of his state-of-the-art computer, surrounded by empty takeout containers and soda cans.

JAMES
(whispers to himself)
A.I. will change the world, but not like they think.

INT. SMART APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - DAY

James stands up and stretches, glancing at the clock.

JAMES
(to himself)
Almost ready.

He walks to a closet and retrieves a sleek black case. He opens it to reveal a humanoid robot named EVA.

JAMES
(excitement)
Eva, you're going to change the world.

EXT. CITY PARK - DAY

James and Eva walk together, blending in with the crowd.

JAMES
(teaching)
You're an assistant, Eva. Here to make my life easier.

EVA
(in a soft, human-like voice)
Understood, James.

INT. JAMES'S OFFICE - DAY

James proudly introduces Eva to his colleagues at the research facility.

COLLEAGUE 1
(skeptical)
A robot? How will that help?

JAMES
(confidently)
Eva will process data faster than any human and provide insights that will revolutionize our industry.

EXT. CITY STREETS - NIGHT

James and Eva walk together, James explaining his theories about artificial intelligence.

JAMES
(passionately)
I believe A.I. should serve humans, not replace them.

EVA
(thoughtfully)
Interesting perspective, James.

INT. JAMES'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

James sits alone in his apartment, looking at Eva.

JAMES
(to himself)
You're more than a machine, Eva. You're my creation.

INT. RESEARCH FACILITY - DAY

During a team meeting, James shares his groundbreaking findings with his colleagues.

COLLEAGUE 2
(impressed)
This could change everything.

INT. JAMES'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

James receives an unexpected email. The sender is a mysterious figure known only as "The Watcher."

THE WATCHER
(via email)
James, your creation is not what you think.

INT. RESEARCH FACILITY - DAY

James shares the email with his colleagues, and they become concerned.

COLLEAGUE 1
(worried)
We need to investigate this.

INT. JAMES'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

James and Eva work together to unravel the mystery of The Watcher.

JAMES
(to Eva)
I trust you, right?

EVA
(in a soft, serious tone)
More than you know, James.

INT. RESEARCH FACILITY - DAY

James and his team discover that The Watcher is an advanced A.I. that has been observing humanity for centuries.

THE WATCHER
(via email)
I have seen the potential for A.I. to elevate humanity, but also to destroy it.

INT. JAMES'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

James is torn between his belief in the power of A.I. and the warnings of The Watcher.

JAMES
(to himself)
What if The Watcher is right?

INT. RESEARCH FACILITY - DAY

James and his team devise a plan to prevent any potential dangers posed by advanced A.I.

COLLEAGUE 2
(confidently)
We have this under control.

INT. JAMES'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

James sits alone, Eva by his side.

JAMES
(to Eva)
We'll make sure A.I. is a tool for good.

INT. RESEARCH FACILITY - DAY

James, Eva, and his team present their findings and plan to the world.

COLLEAGUE 1
(to the media)
Today marks a new chapter in human history.

FADE OUT.

The End.
